segments.normalizedSource: ```swift class LineAnnotation: PDFAnnotation { override func draw(with box: PDFDisplayBox, in context: CGContext) { // Draw original content under the new content. super.draw(with: box, in: context) // Draw a custom purple line. UIGraphicsPushContext(context) context.saveGState() let path = UIBezierPath() path.lineWidth = 10 path.move(to: CGPoint(x: bounds.minX + startPoint.x, y: bounds.minY + startPoint.y)) path.addLine(to: CGPoint(x: bounds.minX + endPoint.x, y: bounds.minY + endPoint.y)) UIColor.systemPurple.setStroke() path.stroke() context.restoreGState() UIGraphicsPopContext() } } ```
